titleEn: Mammograms can do more than detect breast cancer – they also offer important clues on heart health
titleZh: 乳腺 X 线检查不仅能发现乳腺癌，还可能提供心脏健康线索
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: If you’re a woman over 40, you have no doubt heard your doctor tell you to get a mammogram as part of routine screening for breast cancer. But there’s another reason, too.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你是一位40岁以上的女性，你肯定听过医生告诉你要做乳房X光检查，作为乳腺癌常规筛查的一部分，但还有另一个原因。

paragraphs.en: A mammogram can show no sign of breast cancer and still reveal something worth discussing with a doctor: calcium deposits in the medium-sized arteries that carry blood to the breast. These calcium deposits may offer a clue to a woman’s future heart health.
paragraphs.zh: 乳房X光检查虽然没有显示出乳腺癌的迹象，但仍然可以发现一些值得与医生讨论的问题：将血液输送到乳房的中型动脉中的钙沉积。这些钙沉积可能为女性未来的心脏健康提供线索。

paragraphs.en: I’m a cardiologist who studies cardiovascular health around menopause. My colleagues and I have investigated how mammograms might help identify women who are at increased risk of heart disease and stroke. Artificial intelligence now makes these calcium deposits – called breast arterial calcification, or BAC – easier to measure.
paragraphs.zh: 我是一名心脏病专家，研究更年期前后的心血管健康。我和同事研究了乳房X光检查如何帮助识别心脏病和中风风险增加的女性。人工智能现在使这些钙沉积--称为乳腺动脉钙化，简称BAC --更容易测量。

paragraphs.en: In October 2026, Maryland became the first U.S. state to require mammography centers to notify patients in writing if these calcium deposits are found in their mammograms. Other states may institute similar rules soon. Research shows that these calcium deposits are a robust marker for cardiovascular risk, and I expect its adoption to grow.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月，马里兰州成为美国第一个要求乳房X光检查中心在乳房X光检查中发现这些钙沉积物时以书面形式通知患者的州。其他州可能很快就会制定类似的规则。研究表明，这些钙沉积物是心血管风险的一个强有力的标志，我预计它的采用会越来越多。

paragraphs.en: Here’s what women need to know about calcium deposits in the breast – and what they should do if their mammogram shows they have them.
paragraphs.zh: 以下是女性需要了解的关于乳房中钙沉积的信息，以及如果乳房X光检查显示有钙沉积，她们应该怎么做。

paragraphs.en: What is breast arterial calcification?
paragraphs.zh: 什么是乳腺动脉钙化？

paragraphs.en: Breast arterial calcification is calcium buildup in the walls of medium-sized arteries that carry blood through the breast. On a mammogram image, the calcium deposits appear as parallel white lines tracing those vessels.
paragraphs.zh: 乳房动脉钙化是指在乳房中输送血液的中等大小的动脉壁上的钙沉积。在乳房X线照片上，钙沉积物显示为平行的白色线，沿着这些血管。

paragraphs.en: This finding is not a sign of breast cancer. And it differs from the fatty and calcified plaque that can narrow arteries supplying the heart muscle. In the case of breast arterial calcification, the calcium lies mainly in the artery’s muscular wall, where it is associated with blood vessel stiffening.
paragraphs.zh: 这一发现并不是乳腺癌的征兆。它与脂肪和钙化斑块不同，脂肪和钙化斑块会使供应心肌的动脉变窄。在乳腺动脉钙化的情况下，钙主要存在于动脉的肌肉壁，在那里它与血管硬化有关。

paragraphs.en: Finding breast arterial calcification on a mammogram does not, by itself, establish that a woman has heart disease or a blocked heart artery. But research has now clearly shown that this marker signals that a person’s risk of these outcomes is elevated.
paragraphs.zh: 在乳房X光检查中发现乳房动脉钙化本身并不能证明女性患有心脏病或心脏动脉阻塞。但现在研究清楚地表明，这种标记物表明一个人出现这些结果的风险升高。

paragraphs.en: It’s important to remember, however, that its absence does not rule out cardiovascular disease or an increased risk of heart attack or stroke.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，重要的是要记住，缺乏它并不排除心血管疾病或心脏病发作或中风的风险增加。

paragraphs.en: A well-studied connection
paragraphs.zh: 一个经过充分研究的联系

paragraphs.en: Doctors have known about breast arterial calcification for decades, with studies in the 1980s linking it to diabetes and advanced kidney disease. Early findings about its relationship with heart disease were mixed, and many studies were small and relied on radiologists’ visual review of mammograms.
paragraphs.zh: 几十年前，医生们就已经知道了乳腺动脉钙化，20世纪80年代的研究将其与糖尿病和晚期肾脏疾病联系起来。关于它与心脏病的关系，早期的研究结果褒贬不一，许多研究规模都很小，而且依赖于放射科医生对乳房X光片的目视检查。

paragraphs.en: In 2022, my colleagues and I published the results of a 10-year study in which radiologists reviewed mammograms of more than 1,000 women to identify these calcium deposits. Women who had them had about three times the odds of developing coronary heart disease and five times the odds of having a stroke compared with women who didn’t, even after taking age into account.
paragraphs.zh: 2022年，我和我的同事发表了一项为期10年的研究结果。在这项研究中，放射科医生对1,000多名女性的乳房X光片进行了检查，以识别这些钙沉积。即使考虑到年龄因素，与没有钙沉积的女性相比，有钙沉积的女性患冠心病的几率大约是没有钙沉积的女性的三倍，患中风的几率是没有钙沉积的女性的五倍。

paragraphs.en: To confirm that breast arterial calcification in mammograms predicts cardiovascular risk, we assessed 45 published studies involving more than 68,000 women, in a type of study called a meta-analysis. This work, published in 2026, found that women who had these calcium deposits in their breast arteries on a mammogram had roughly twice the risk of stroke, heart failure and death from any cause, and nearly three times the risk of dying from heart disease, compared with women who did not.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证实乳房X光片中的乳腺动脉钙化可以预测心血管风险，我们评估了45项已发表的研究，涉及超过6.8万名女性，这是一项名为荟萃分析的研究。这项研究发表于2026年，发现乳房X光片中乳腺动脉中有这些钙沉积的女性，中风、心力衰竭和任何原因导致的死亡风险大约是其他女性的两倍，死于心脏病的风险几乎是不吸烟的女性的三倍。

paragraphs.en: The studies we analyzed differed considerably in design and quality, so these averages cannot precisely predict an individual woman’s cardiovascular risk. Also, while these findings establish an association between breast arterial calcification and cardiovascular disease, they do not show that calcium in the breast arteries causes those health outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析的研究在设计和质量上存在很大差异，因此这些平均值无法准确预测个体女性的心血管风险。此外，尽管这些发现建立了乳房动脉钙化和心血管疾病之间的联系，但它们并没有表明乳房动脉中的钙导致这些健康结果。

paragraphs.en: Integrating AI and age
paragraphs.zh: AI与年龄的融合

paragraphs.en: Radiologists can see breast artery calcium on a routine mammogram. But there’s no common standard for grading and reporting how much calcification is present. AI tools which are being used more commonly by doctors can measure how much is there using the same images, with no extra radiation.
paragraphs.zh: 放射科医生可以在常规的乳房X光片上看到乳房动脉钙化。但是没有统一的标准来分级和报告钙化的程度。医生们更常用的人工智能工具可以使用相同的图像来测量钙化的程度，而不需要额外的辐射。

paragraphs.en: These calcium deposits become more common with age, so my colleagues and I used AI to assess data from more than 100,000 women in nine countries in order to map how calcium builds up in breast arteries by age. We developed and tested a metric that, when added to standard tools, improved doctors’ ability to accurately predict a woman’s risk of cardiovascular disease.
paragraphs.zh: 随着年龄的增长，这些钙沉积变得越来越普遍，所以我和我的同事们使用人工智能来评估来自9个国家的10多万名女性的数据，以绘制钙在乳房动脉中的年龄分布图。我们开发并测试了一种度量标准，当添加到标准工具中时，可以提高医生准确预测女性患心血管疾病风险的能力。

paragraphs.en: Integrating a new risk marker
paragraphs.zh: 集成新的风险标记

paragraphs.en: Maryland became the first state to require a notice about breast arterial calcification in screening results. The goal is to give women who have it a reason to talk with their doctor about heart health.
paragraphs.zh: 马里兰州成为第一个要求在筛查结果中注明乳腺动脉钙化的州，目的是让患有乳腺动脉钙化的女性有理由与医生讨论心脏健康问题。

paragraphs.en: The bill’s sponsor modeled the law on a 2023 regulation on breast density notices, which required mammography centers to inform patients and their doctors about their breast density and its link to cancer detection. The breast density rule was first implemented in Connecticut and then adopted by many other states, before becoming a nationwide requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 该法案的发起人以2023年的一项关于乳腺密度通知的法规为蓝本制定了这项法律，该法规要求乳房X光检查中心向患者及其医生告知他们的乳腺密度及其与癌症检测的联系。乳腺密度规则首先在康涅狄格州实施，然后被其他许多州采用，然后成为全国性的要求。

paragraphs.en: An Australian trial called TIM-TAM will test whether using breast arterial calcification to guide care improves measures of heart health. Researchers still need to find out whether treating women based on the presence of breast arterial calcification prevents heart attacks or strokes. But research already shows that the marker has a link to cardiovascular disease, and I expect it to follow a similar pattern of adoption as reporting breast density.
paragraphs.zh: 澳大利亚一项名为TIM-TAM的试验将测试使用乳腺动脉钙化来指导护理是否会改善心脏健康指标。研究人员仍需要弄清楚根据乳腺动脉钙化的存在来治疗女性是否可以预防心脏病发作或中风。但研究已经表明该标记物与心血管疾病有关，我预计它会遵循与报告乳腺密度类似的采用模式。

paragraphs.en: Until other states adjust their requirements, look for “breast arterial calcification” or “vascular calcifications” in the radiologist’s report. Mammography centers’ reporting practices vary, so some reports may omit BAC even when it’s visible. Some imaging centers offer an optional AI review for breast arterial calcification as an out-of-pocket add-on to a screening mammogram.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他州调整他们的要求之前，在放射科医生的报告中寻找“乳腺动脉钙化”或“血管钙化”。乳房X光检查中心的报告实践各不相同，因此即使BAC可见，一些报告也可能省略BAC。一些成像中心提供可选的乳腺动脉钙化AI审查，作为筛查乳房X光检查的自付附加功能。

paragraphs.en: What this means for your care
paragraphs.zh: 这对您的护理意味着什么

paragraphs.en: On its own, the presence of breast arterial calcification on a mammogram does not determine whether someone needs a heart test or a new prescription. But in my view, this marker can provide a useful nudge to get an updated assessment of cardiovascular health.
paragraphs.zh: 就其本身而言，乳房X光片上的乳腺动脉钙化并不能决定一个人是否需要进行心脏检查或开新的处方。但在我看来，这个标志物可以提供一个有用的推动，以获得心血管健康的最新评估。

paragraphs.en: Your doctor may suggest a blood pressure measurement and blood tests for cholesterol and kidney function. An estimate called eGFR describes how well the kidneys filter blood.
paragraphs.zh: 你的医生可能会建议你测量血压，并进行胆固醇和肾功能的血液检查。一个叫做eGFR的估计值描述了肾脏过滤血液的能力。

paragraphs.en: Your doctor can use these results alongside age, smoking, diabetes and other information in the American Heart Association’s PREVENT calculator. It estimates the chance of developing cardiovascular disease over the next 10 years for adults ages 30 to 79 who are not already diagnosed with cardiovascular disease.
paragraphs.zh: 你的医生可以将这些结果与年龄、吸烟、糖尿病和其他信息一起用于美国心脏协会的PREVENT计算器。它估计了30至79岁的成年人在未来10年内患心血管疾病的可能性，这些人还没有被诊断出患有心血管疾病。

paragraphs.en: You can then discuss with your doctor which steps could make the biggest difference for your heart health depending on your risk. That might mean finding ways to move more, choosing foods that are good for your heart or getting help to quit smoking if you smoke. Depending on your overall risk, your doctor may also suggest taking a statin to lower your cholesterol or starting or adjusting blood pressure medicine. These treatments can help lower your chances of a heart attack or stroke.
paragraphs.zh: 然后，你可以和你的医生讨论，根据你的风险，哪些步骤可以对你的心脏健康产生最大的影响。这可能意味着找到更多的方法，选择对你的心脏有益的食物，或者如果你吸烟，请帮助戒烟。根据你的整体风险，你的医生也可能建议服用他汀类药物来降低你的胆固醇，或者开始服用或调整血压药物。这些治疗可以帮助降低你的风险。心脏病发作或中风

paragraphs.en: A routine breast screening visit can thus become an opportunity to help women understand their cardiovascular risk and take steps to lower it.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，常规的乳房筛查可以成为一个机会，帮助妇女了解他们的心血管风险，并采取措施降低它。
